title: Automatic Crack Segmentation and Feature Extraction in Electroluminescence Images of Solar Modules (PV-Vision)
mechanism: From segmented cracks and busbars, compute the crack-isolated area (region cut off from all busbars) as worst-case inactive area, plus crack length and brightness inside the isolated area.
adaptation: Build an isolated-region map from our predicted crack plus ribbon/busbar classes and feed it as an extra input to a second-stage inactive head (inactive touches a crack in 99% of cases). Same map gives a severity output. Public DuraMAT crack set (1,272/206/359) usable as an external cross-dataset test.
min_experiment: Step 0 (CPU): on val compute isolated area from GT crack + ribbon masks; kill if it covers < 50% of GT inactive pixels. Step 1: arm PF + isolated map into stage-2 inactive head v PF, 5 seeds; metric inactive IoU; kill if < +0.02.
evidence: R: UNet-VGG16 crack F1 0.875, IoU 0.782 on their own test set (359 cells, includes busbar class); companion PVSC 2022 paper predicts maximum inactive area from detected cracks.

alt_notes.adaptation: Same per-dataset-head joint training as MSPS; map its dark area class to a second inactive head to attack the 42-cell inactive shortage; resample 400 px to our scale. Hold out its test split as an external crack test set for the benchmark.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PF + LBNL joint with own head. Baseline: PF, 5 v 5 seeds. Metrics: E1 crack relF1@2, test inactive IoU (BMRK cells), test crack IoU. Kill if E1 relF1@2 gain < 0.03 and inactive IoU gain < 0.02.

alt_notes.adaptation: Physics prior for inactive (99% of our inactive regions touch a crack label): build crack-bounded regions from predicted crack + busbar + border masks and relabel a region inactive if its mean EL is below a source-wise fraction of the cell median; union / vote with the network's inactive map. Also an open baseline for the benchmark suite.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house 5-seed ensemble + region rule (threshold tuned on CV folds only); baseline: same ensemble. Metric: CV inactive IoU and relR. Kill if inactive IoU < +0.02.

alt_notes.adaptation: Run its released model under our protocol as a published EL baseline; use its crack features for severity; its crack set is possible extra data (D02 / D03).
alt_notes.min_experiment: No training arm: inference of PV-Vision model on our test-clean and E1 under our metrics (crack IoU, relF1@2). Then optional joint training with its crack set vs house; kill if test crack IoU < +0.012.

alt_notes.adaptation: Run the released model under our protocol as a published EL baseline; its features feed the severity track; its dataset is extra data for D02/D03.
alt_notes.min_experiment: No training arm: evaluate released PV-Vision weights on test-clean and E1 crack relF1@2 and IoU under our protocol (benchmark row). Kill not applicable.

alt_notes.adaptation: Third pixel-labelled EL crack source for joint training; its high IoU suggests wide crack labels (unverified), so it must enter through source conditioning or a separate head. Crack-isolated-area features give a severity baseline.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Measure its median crack label width first. Then add it as a source in the joint run (MultiTalent arm) vs joint run without it; 5 seeds each. Metric: clean-49 crack IoU, E1 crack recall. Kill if no gain >= 0.012 crack IoU or +0.03 E1 recall. ~15 GPU-h.

alt_notes.adaptation: Use our predicted crack + ribbons (+ busbars) + border masks. Interior components touching no ribbon are isolated. If an isolated part is darker than a per-source threshold fitted on train, label it inactive and OR it with the model's inactive. For half-cut E1 cells, add the cut edge as a barrier.
alt_notes.min_experiment: CPU post-processing on PF and PF-ensemble predictions; thresholds fitted on module-grouped 5-fold CV (532 cells). Metrics: inactive IoU, P / R, BMRK inactive IoU on CV and E1. Kill if CV inactive IoU gain < +0.02 or precision drop > 0.05. <2 GPU-h.
